title: Silver at a 20-day high in euros but not in dollars
system: Stand-alone silver rule (XAG/USD), signal from XAG/USD / EUR/USD; replication of gold-euro-divergence

rule.signal: silver in euros (XAG/USD / EUR/USD close) beyond its 20-day closing extreme while XAG/USD's is not: long (high) / short (low)
rule.stop: k x ATR(20) before the entry
rule.costs: $0.06 a trade, no financing (no silver rate in council/fills.mjs)

tests.what: both sides, hold 5 candles, stop 2 x ATR(20) (primary)
long signals only, hold 5 candles, stop 2 x ATR(20) (descriptive: under 100 events a window)
both sides, hold 10 candles, stop 3 x ATR(20)

headline: FAIL, 0 of 2: buying (selling) silver after a 20-day high (low) in euros but not in dollars makes +0.002R a trade net out of sample 2017-26 (n 83, month t +0.03); it beats 31 of 40 placebos.
